Set up Microsoft sign-in for Azure Cosmos DB

Source: R/backend__cosmos.R
oauth_db_cosmos_client.Rd

Create a Microsoft Entra client for a Shiny app that reads Azure Cosmos DB for NoSQL with each visitor's account. Pass it to shinyOAuth's UI and server modules, then use oauth_db_cosmos_api() inside server().

Usage

oauth_db_cosmos_client(
  tenant_id,
  client_id,
  redirect_uri,
  client_secret = NULL,
  ...,
  resource = "https://cosmos.azure.com",
  provider = shinyOAuth::oauth_provider_microsoft(tenant = tenant_id, id_token_validation
    = TRUE, userinfo_required = FALSE),
  scopes = c("openid", "profile", "offline_access", paste0(resource, "/.default")),
  token_targets = list(cosmos = list(resource = resource, scopes = paste0(resource,
    "/.default"), required_scopes = character())),
  token_target_default = "cosmos"
)

Arguments

tenant_id

Microsoft Entra tenant ID. Ignored when provider is supplied.

client_id

Application ID from the OAuth registration.

redirect_uri

Registered URL where the browser returns after sign-in.

client_secret

Client secret, or NULL for a public client.

...

Other arguments for shinyOAuth::oauth_client().

resource

Cosmos DB token audience, default "https://cosmos.azure.com". Change this with provider for another Azure cloud or an account-specific audience accepted by your deployment.

provider

Custom shinyOAuth provider, replacing the default.

scopes

OAuth consent scopes, replacing the defaults.

token_targets

Named token targets, replacing the Cosmos DB default.

token_target_default

Default token target name.

Value

A shinyOAuth OAuthClient. Create it outside server().

Details

Use your own Microsoft Entra Web application registration with the exact redirect URI. The preset requests the resource's .default scope and keeps its token in the "cosmos" target. .default is a consent marker, not an operation permission checked by the database helper.

Cosmos DB doesn't publish a delegated permission in the app-registration permission picker. Validate that your tenant and registration permit a user token for this resource before deploying. Sign-in configuration and Cosmos DB data-plane role assignments are separate requirements. The preset doesn't use Azure CLI, managed identity or account keys.

See also

oauth_db_cosmos_api(). vignette("cosmos", package = "shinyOAuthDB") has setup steps and a complete app.
